Cilesime të tjera mbi Rezidencen
GRADIENT CENTER TIRANA Është një ndërtesë rezidenciale e pozicionuar në Rrugën Liqeni Thate, me pamje mahnitese ndërmjet dy liqeneve: Liqenit të Tiranës dhe "Liqeni Thate".
Me një pozicion strategjik dhe afër natyrës, Rezidenca Gradient është një vend ideal për ata që kërkojnë një jetese komode, me lehtësi për t’u lidhur me qytetin dhe Parkun e Liqenit.
Gradient Center Tirana zhvillohet ne nje siperfaqe trualli 6189m2 ku struktura e nderteses ze nje siperfaqe prej 1364m2 dhe do te kete nje hapesire te perbashket per komunitetin prej 4825m2 .
title_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment at Gradient Residence in Lake Dry!
description_en: The apartment is located in a New Residence in the Dry Lake area with a view of Tirana Lake. • New Building • 4th residential floor • Total Area: 93.63 M2 • Net Area: 74.49 M2 • Regular Size • North-East Orientation • Natural Lighting • 1 Optional Parking Space with an additional value of 35,000 Euros Apartment Organized by: • Spacious living room with cooking area • Distribution corridor • Room bedroom • Toilet •Balcony with a fantastic view of the Lake Other details about the Residence GRADIENT CENTER TIRANA It is a residential building located on Ruga Liqeni Thate, with a stunning view between two lakes: Lake Tirana and "Liqeni Thate". With a strategic position and close to nature, Gradient Residence is an ideal place for those looking for a comfortable lifestyle, easily connected to the city and the Lake Park. Gradient Center Tirana is developed on a land area of ​​6189m2 where the building structure occupies an area of ​​1364m2 and there will be a common space for the community of 4825m2.
